newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares close up, Shenzhen down.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares close up, Shenzhen down.

text.p: Chinese foreign currency B shares ended mixed on Thursday after Beijing rattled investor confidence with a call for improved market risk control, brokers said.
Shenzhen's B index ended down on the day, but Shanghai reversed early losses to end slightly up.

The Shanghai B index rose 0.610 point or 0.71 percent to 86.958 on volume of 39.816 million shares worth $23.245 million, led by gains in Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor which boosted buying interest in blue-chips, brokers said.

Official financial newspapers reported on Thursday that the China Securities Regulatory Commission would focus its 1997 work on strengthening market supervision and standardising market activity in a drive to improve risk control.
Shanghai Refrigerator was the most actively traded stock and the second biggest gainer, ending at a historical high by jumping $0.048 or 7.16 percent to $0.718 on volume of 3.5 million shares.
"Shanghai Refrigerator offered a good bonus issue, which was attractive to investors," said one broker.

The company's board of directors proposed a three-for-10 bonus issue and a three-for-10 rights issue, pending approval at a shareholders meeting scheduled for May 30, the company said in a statement on Thursday.

"The market is likely to consolidate around current levels in the short term due to uncertainties over unpublished 1996 results and Beijing's further measures to cool down the market," another broker said.
The Shenzhen B index closed down 1.30 points or 0.74 percent at 175.79 on turnover of HK$156.6 million, against HK$135.4 million on Wednesday.
Watchmaker Shenzhen Fiyta Holdings Ltd was the biggest loser, dropping HK$0.24 or 3.92 percent to HK$5.88 on volume of 131,860 shares.
Shanghai's A share index edged up on institutional buying in selected stocks late in the session, but most investors were cautious, brokers said.
The index inched up 1.279 points or 0.09 percent to 1,443.897 points on volume of 933.0 million shares worth 13.0 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index rose 45.458 points or 1.21 percent to 3,792.197 points.
The Shenzhen A share index reversed earlier losses and gained 3.71 points or 0.78 percent to 481.51 on turnover of 14.0 billion yuan against Wednesday's 12.2 billion.
